subtitle.en: Sentence foundations: make every verb match its subject
subtitle.bn: বাক্যের ভিত্তি: প্রতিটা verb-কে তার subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলানো

title.en: Building Blocks and the Core Rule

intro.en: Learn the parts of a sentence and the one rule behind agreement: the verb must match its subject in number.
intro.bn: বাক্যের অংশগুলো আর agreement-এর মূল নিয়মটা শিখুন: verb-কে number-এ তার subject-এর সঙ্গে মিলতে হবে।

greeting.en: One small -s decides a lot of marks. Let's get it right.
greeting.bn: ছোট্ট একটা -s অনেক নম্বর ঠিক করে দেয়। চলুন এটা ঠিক করে নিই।

learned.en: Subject, verb and object (S + V + O)
learned.bn: Subject, verb আর object (S + V + O)

learned.en: The -s rule: plural on nouns, singular on verbs
The irregular forms of be and have

prompt.en: Bangla speakers often write one of these in Task 1. Which sentence is correct?
prompt.bn: বাংলাভাষীরা Task 1-এ প্রায়ই এর একটা লেখেন। কোন বাক্যটি সঠিক?

options.en: The population increase rapidly.
The population increases rapidly.

explain.en: “The population” is singular, so the verb takes -s: increases. The Bangla verb does not change for singular and plural (যায় is the same for “he” and “they”), so your ear doesn't warn you when the -s is missing.
explain.bn: “The population” singular, তাই verb-এ -s বসবে: increases। বাংলা verb singular-plural-এ বদলায় না (“he” আর “they” দুটোর জন্যই যায়), তাই -s বাদ পড়লে আপনার কান সতর্ক করে না।

items.en: The building blocks: subject, verb, object
The eight cases where the true subject is hidden
items.bn: যে ৮টি case-এ আসল subject লুকানো থাকে

items.en: Why agreement errors cap your band
items.bn: Agreement ভুল কেন আপনার band আটকে দেয়

note.en: Fixing agreement is the single highest-value, lowest-effort accuracy gain in the whole exam.
note.bn: পুরো পরীক্ষায় সবচেয়ে কম পরিশ্রমে accuracy-তে সবচেয়ে বড় লাভ হলো agreement ঠিক করা।

intro.en: Almost every grammar rule is stated with these labels, so learn to recognise them. Tap through each card.
intro.bn: প্রায় প্রতিটা grammar নিয়ম এই নামগুলো দিয়েই বলা হয়, তাই এগুলো চিনতে শিখুন। প্রতিটা card-এ tap করুন।

body.en: The person or thing the sentence is about - the one that does the action. In “Students study hard,” the subject is **students**.
body.bn: যাকে নিয়ে বাক্যটি - যে কাজটা করে। “Students study hard,” বাক্যে subject হলো **students**।

body.en: The action or the state of being. In “Students study hard,” the verb is **study**. The verb be (is, am, are, was, were) shows a state: “The graph is clear.”
body.bn: কাজ, বা কোনো অবস্থা। “Students study hard,” বাক্যে verb হলো **study**। Verb be (is, am, are, was, were) অবস্থা বোঝায়: “The graph is clear.”

body.en: The person or thing that receives the action. In “Students use the internet,” the object is **the internet**.
body.bn: যার ওপর কাজটা হয়। “Students use the internet,” বাক্যে object হলো **the internet**।

body.en: English puts the verb second, right after the subject: “I eat rice.” Bangla puts it at the end (আমি ভাত খাই). If a sentence feels wrong, check whether the verb has drifted to the end.
body.bn: English-এ verb বসে দ্বিতীয় স্থানে, subject-এর ঠিক পরে: “I eat rice.” বাংলায় verb থাকে শেষে (আমি ভাত খাই)। বাক্য ভুল ভুল লাগলে দেখুন verb-টা শেষে চলে গেছে কি না।

body.en: The verb must match its subject in number. A singular subject (one) takes one form of the verb; a plural subject (more than one) takes another. That is the entire idea.
body.bn: Verb-কে number-এ তার subject-এর সঙ্গে মিলতে হবে। Singular subject (একটি) verb-এর এক রূপ নেয়; plural subject (একাধিক) নেয় আরেক রূপ। পুরো ধারণাটা এটুকুই।

prompt.en: In “Students use the internet,” which word or phrase is the object?
prompt.bn: “Students use the internet,” বাক্যে object কোনটা?

options.en: Students
use
the internet

explain.en: The internet receives the action, so it is the object. Students (S) use (V) the internet (O) - the normal English order.
explain.bn: The internet-এর ওপর কাজটা হচ্ছে, তাই এটা object। Students (S) use (V) the internet (O) - English-এর স্বাভাবিক ক্রম।

options.en: The students works hard.
The students work hard.
The student work hard.

explain.en: On a noun, -s means plural; on a verb, -s means singular. So the -s goes on the noun or the verb, not both: the students work / the student works.
explain.bn: Noun-এ -s মানে plural; verb-এ -s মানে singular। তাই -s বসে হয় noun-এ, নয় verb-এ - দুটোতে নয়: the students work / the student works।

title.en: The irregular pair: be and have

intro.en: A very common Task 1 sentence. “The graph” and “pollution” are both singular.
intro.bn: Task 1-এর খুব সাধারণ একটা বাক্য। “The graph” আর “pollution” দুটোই singular।

weak.text: The graph show that pollution have increased.

strong.text: The graph shows that pollution has increased.

tip.en: Singular subject: is / was / has, and -s on present-simple verbs. Plural subject: are / were / have, and the base verb.
tip.bn: Singular subject: is / was / has, আর present simple verb-এ -s। Plural subject: are / were / have, আর base verb।

options.en: Many people is using the internet.
Many people are using the internet.

explain.en: “Many people” is plural, so the verb is “are”. Bangla often has no separate word for “is” (সে ভালো = “he good”), so learners drop it or pick the wrong number.
explain.bn: “Many people” plural, তাই verb হবে “are”। বাংলায় সাধারণ বাক্যে প্রায়ই “is”-এর আলাদা শব্দ থাকে না (সে ভালো = “he good”), তাই শিক্ষার্থীরা এটা বাদ দেন বা ভুল number বেছে নেন।

intro.en: The first three tricky cases: words between subject and verb, “the number of” vs “a number of”, and collective nouns.
intro.bn: প্রথম তিনটি কঠিন case: subject আর verb-এর মাঝের শব্দ, “the number of” বনাম “a number of”, আর collective noun।

greeting.en: The nearest noun is usually a trap. Let's find the true subject.
greeting.bn: সবচেয়ে কাছের noun-টা সাধারণত একটা ফাঁদ। চলুন আসল subject খুঁজে বের করি।

learned.en: Agree with the true subject, not the nearest noun
learned.bn: সবচেয়ে কাছের noun নয়, আসল subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলানো

learned.en: “The number of” is singular; “a number of” is plural
learned.bn: “The number of” singular; “a number of” plural

learned.en: Collective nouns take a singular verb in IELTS writing
learned.bn: IELTS writing-এ collective noun singular verb নেয়

title.en: Which noun does the verb follow?

options.en: The list of items are on the table.
The list of items is on the table.

explain.en: The subject is “list” (singular), not “items”. Writers are pulled toward the closest word, which is usually wrong. Cross out the middle phrase: “The list … is.”
explain.bn: Subject হলো “list” (singular), “items” নয়। লেখকরা সবচেয়ে কাছের শব্দের দিকে টান অনুভব করেন, আর সেটা সাধারণত ভুল। মাঝের phrase-টা কেটে দিন: “The list … is.”

title.en: Case 1 · Words between subject and verb
title.bn: Case 1 · Subject আর verb-এর মাঝের শব্দ

options.en: The list of approved candidates are posted on the noticeboard.
The list of approved candidates is posted on the noticeboard.

explain.en: Delete the words between the subject and the verb: “The list … is posted.” The subject is “list” (singular), not “candidates”.
explain.bn: Subject আর verb-এর মাঝের শব্দগুলো মুছে ফেলুন: “The list … is posted.” Subject হলো “list” (singular), “candidates” নয়।

intro.en: Two cases you will meet constantly in Writing Task 1 and Task 2.
intro.bn: দুটো case যা Writing Task 1 আর Task 2-এ বারবার পাবেন।

body.en:
“The number of + plural noun” takes a singular verb: the subject is **number**, one figure.
The number of tourists has increased since 2010.
body.bn:
“The number of + plural noun” singular verb নেয়: subject হলো **number**, একটি সংখ্যা।
The number of tourists has increased since 2010.

body.en:
“A number of + plural noun” takes a plural verb: it simply means **several**.
A number of tourists were waiting outside the museum.
body.bn:
“A number of + plural noun” plural verb নেয়: এর মানে শুধু **কয়েকটি**।
A number of tourists were waiting outside the museum.

body.en:
Government, team, committee, family, company, public, staff name a group. In IELTS academic writing, treat each as a single unit with a singular verb.
The government is planning three new policies.
body.bn:
Government, team, committee, family, company, public, staff - এগুলো একটি দলের নাম। IELTS academic writing-এ প্রতিটিকে একটি একক ধরে singular verb দিন।
The government is planning three new policies.

body.en: British English sometimes allows a plural verb when the focus is on the members (“the team are arguing among themselves”). For IELTS academic Writing, stay singular and consistent - it is safer and never wrong.
body.bn: British English-এ কখনো কখনো plural verb চলে, যখন জোরটা সদস্যদের ওপর (“the team are arguing among themselves”)। IELTS academic Writing-এ singular-এই থাকুন, ধারাবাহিক থাকুন - এটা নিরাপদ, আর কখনো ভুল হয় না।

options.en: The number of tourists have increased since 2010.
The number of tourists has increased since 2010.

explain.en: The subject is “number” - one figure - so the verb is singular: has increased. “Tourists” is not the subject.
explain.bn: Subject হলো “number” - একটি সংখ্যা - তাই verb singular: has increased। “Tourists” subject নয়।

prompt.en: A number of tourists ______ waiting outside the museum.
prompt.bn: A number of tourists ______ waiting outside the museum.

options.en: was
were

explain.en: “A number of” simply means “several”, so it takes a plural verb: were. It behaves in the opposite way to “the number of”.
explain.bn: “A number of” মানে শুধু “কয়েকটি”, তাই plural verb: were। এটা “the number of”-এর ঠিক উল্টো আচরণ করে।

intro.en: The same sentence about a government - treat the group as one unit.
intro.bn: Government নিয়ে একই বাক্য - দলটাকে একটি একক হিসেবে ধরুন।

weak.text: The government are introducing a new tax next year.

strong.text: The government is introducing a new tax next year.

tip.en: Government, team, committee, family, company, public, staff: one unit, singular verb, and keep it consistent.
tip.bn: Government, team, committee, family, company, public, staff: একটি একক, singular verb, আর পুরো লেখায় ধারাবাহিক রাখুন।

prompt.en: Which sentence follows the IELTS academic rule for collective nouns?
prompt.bn: Collective noun-এর IELTS academic নিয়ম কোন বাক্যটি মানছে?

options.en: The committee have reached a decision.
The committee has reached a decision.

explain.en: “Committee” names a group; in IELTS academic writing it is one unit, so it takes the singular “has”.
explain.bn: “Committee” একটি দলের নাম; IELTS academic writing-এ এটা একটি একক, তাই singular “has” নেয়।

intro.en: Indefinite pronouns like each and neither, paired connectors like neither…nor, and subjects joined by “and”.
intro.bn: Each, neither-এর মতো indefinite pronoun, neither…nor-এর মতো জোড়া connector, আর “and” দিয়ে জোড়া subject।

greeting.en: “Each of the students” - singular or plural? Let's settle it.
greeting.bn: “Each of the students” - singular না plural? চলুন মীমাংসা করি।

learned.en: With neither…nor / either…or, agree with the nearer subject
learned.bn: Neither…nor / either…or-এ কাছের subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলানো

learned.en: Subjects joined by “and” are almost always plural
learned.bn: “And” দিয়ে জোড়া subject প্রায় সবসময় plural

prompt.en: Each of the students ______ a laptop.
prompt.bn: Each of the students ______ a laptop.

options.en: have
has

explain.en: “Each” is singular, however plural “the students” looks. So the verb is “has”, not “have”.
explain.bn: “Each” singular, “the students” যত plural-ই দেখাক না কেন। তাই verb হবে “has”, “have” নয়।

options.en: Neither of the options are acceptable.
Neither of the options is acceptable.

explain.en: “Neither” (on its own, meaning “not one of them”) is an indefinite pronoun, so it is singular: Neither of the options is acceptable.
explain.bn: “Neither” (একা, মানে “কোনোটাই না”) একটি indefinite pronoun, তাই singular: Neither of the options is acceptable।

title.en: Case 5 · Neither…nor, either…or, not only…but also
title.bn: Case 5 · Neither…nor, either…or, not only…but also

prompt.en: Neither the manager nor the employees ______ informed.
prompt.bn: Neither the manager nor the employees ______ informed.

options.en: was
were

explain.en: With paired connectors the verb agrees with the nearer subject. Here that is “employees” (plural), so: were.
explain.bn: জোড়া connector-এ verb মেলে কাছের subject-এর সঙ্গে। এখানে সেটা “employees” (plural), তাই: were।

intro.en: “Neither … nor” joins two subjects. Which one sits next to the verb?
intro.bn: “Neither … nor” দুটো subject জোড়ে। Verb-এর পাশে কোনটা বসেছে?

weak.text: Neither the teacher nor the students was ready for the test.

strong.text: Neither the teacher nor the students were ready for the test.

tip.en: Swap the order and the verb changes too: Neither the employees nor the manager was informed.
tip.bn: ক্রম উল্টে দিলে verb-ও বদলায়: Neither the employees nor the manager was informed.

options.en: Poverty and unemployment remains a serious problem.
Poverty and unemployment remain serious problems.

explain.en: Two subjects joined by “and” are almost always plural, so: remain. The exception is one combined thing, like “Bread and butter is a common breakfast” - rare in IELTS.
explain.bn: “And” দিয়ে জোড়া দুটো subject প্রায় সবসময় plural, তাই: remain। ব্যতিক্রম হলো দুটো মিলে একটাই জিনিস, যেমন “Bread and butter is a common breakfast” - IELTS-এ এটা কমই আসে।

title.en: There Is, Uncountables and Inversion: Cases 7–8
title.bn: There is, Uncountable ও Inversion: Case ৭–৮

intro.en: The last two cases - “there is / there are”, uncountable nouns, amounts and inverted sentences - and why agreement caps your band.
intro.bn: শেষ দুটি case - “there is / there are”, uncountable noun, পরিমাণ আর inverted বাক্য - আর agreement কেন আপনার band আটকে দেয়।

greeting.en: Sometimes the subject comes after the verb. Here's how to catch it.
greeting.bn: কখনো কখনো subject আসে verb-এর পরে। দেখুন কীভাবে ধরবেন।

learned.en: After “there”, agree with the real subject after the verb
learned.bn: “There”-এর পরে verb-এর পরের আসল subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলানো

learned.en: Uncountable nouns are singular, with no plural -s
learned.bn: Uncountable noun singular, কোনো plural -s নেই

learned.en: Amounts of time, money and distance take a singular verb
learned.bn: সময়, টাকা আর দূরত্বের পরিমাণ singular verb নেয়

learned.en: Inverted sentences still agree with the subject
learned.bn: Inverted বাক্যেও verb subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলে

learned.en: Why agreement errors keep you below Band 7
learned.bn: Agreement ভুল কেন Band 7-এর নিচে আটকে রাখে

options.en: is
are

explain.en: After “there”, the verb agrees with the real subject that comes after it. The subject is “range” (singular), not “options”, so: There is a range of options.
explain.bn: “There”-এর পরে verb মেলে তার পরে আসা আসল subject-এর সঙ্গে। Subject হলো “range” (singular), “options” নয়, তাই: There is a range of options।

options.en: There is several factors.
There are several factors.

explain.en: The real subject comes after the verb: “factors” is plural, so the verb is “are”.
explain.bn: আসল subject আসে verb-এর পরে: “factors” plural, তাই verb হবে “are”।

intro.en: These look plural or hide the subject - but the rule still holds.
intro.bn: এগুলো plural দেখায় বা subject লুকিয়ে রাখে - কিন্তু নিয়ম একই থাকে।

body.en: Treated as singular, never with a plural -s. Memorise the set: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work.
body.bn: Singular ধরা হয়, কখনো plural -s নেয় না। এই set-টা মুখস্থ করুন: information, advice, knowledge, research, equipment, furniture, accommodation, traffic, progress, news, money, water, work।

body.en:
Amounts of time, money and distance are one quantity, so they take a singular verb.
Ten years is a long time to wait. / Five thousand taka is not enough.
body.bn:
সময়, টাকা আর দূরত্বের পরিমাণ একটি একক পরিমাণ, তাই singular verb নেয়।
Ten years is a long time to wait. / Five thousand taka is not enough.

body.en:
When the verb comes before the subject (after not only, hardly …), find the subject after the verb and match it.
Hardly ever does the government reverse such a decision.
body.bn:
Verb যখন subject-এর আগে আসে (not only, hardly … দিয়ে শুরু হলে), verb-এর পরে subject-টা খুঁজে তার সঙ্গে মেলান।
Hardly ever does the government reverse such a decision.

weak.text: The informations are correct and he gave many advices.

strong.text: The information is correct and he gave a lot of advice.

tip.en: Uncountable noun = singular verb and no -s: the information is, the research shows, the traffic was.
tip.bn: Uncountable noun = singular verb, কোনো -s নয়: the information is, the research shows, the traffic was।

options.en: Ten years are a long time to wait.
Ten years is a long time to wait.

explain.en: An amount of time is treated as a single quantity, so it takes a singular verb: Ten years is a long time to wait.
explain.bn: সময়ের পরিমাণকে একটি একক পরিমাণ ধরা হয়, তাই singular verb: Ten years is a long time to wait।

title.en: Why Bangla speakers slip - and why it caps your band
title.bn: বাংলাভাষীরা কেন ভুল করেন - আর কেন এটা band আটকে দেয়

options.en: The number of visitors have risen sharply, whereas the proportion of local tourists have fallen.
The number of visitors has risen sharply, whereas the proportion of local tourists have fallen.
The number of visitors has risen sharply, whereas the proportion of local tourists has fallen.

explain.en: Task 1 lives on subjects like “the number of” and “the proportion of” - every one of them is singular, so both verbs take “has”.
explain.bn: Task 1 চলে “the number of”, “the proportion of”-এর মতো subject দিয়ে - এর প্রতিটাই singular, তাই দুটো verb-ই “has” নেয়।
